name: [Shoptet CLI Greenfield] Phase 0 — Spine & Feasibility Gate
description:
Part of the "Shoptet Partner CLI — Greenfield Rebuild" initiative (label: shoptet-cli-greenfield).

Foundational work every later command depends on, plus the feasibility spike that gates the MVP design. Nothing here ships to partners directly.

Scope per cli-greenfield.md §13 Phase 0:

- Monorepo (pnpm + Turborepo + Stricli + tsdown) and package boundaries (§5.5)
- --json envelope, structured errors, exit codes, message catalog (§9)
- Three-scope config resolver: machine / project / derived (§5.7)
- Strict SemVer + Changesets + npm provenance (§4)
- Testing harness + CI matrix (§12)
- Feasibility spike on a real shop proving the proxy/injection/session mechanism works (§5.1.1, §13)

The MVP design (Phase 2) is not committed until the feasibility spike passes.
